achievements.name: Deserted Island
achievements.detail: Choose a deserted island and step off the seaplane to start your life there.

achievements.name: First Tent
achievements.detail: Place the tent Tom Nook gives you and spend your first night in it.

achievements.name: Nook Miles
achievements.detail: Earn Nook Miles by completing a task listed on your NookPhone.

achievements.name: First House
achievements.detail: Pay the Nook Miles Tom Nook asks for so your tent is replaced by a house.

achievements.name: Nook's Cranny
achievements.detail: Deliver the materials Timmy and Tommy need and open Nook's Cranny.

achievements.name: Museum
achievements.detail: Donate fish, bugs, or fossils until Blathers arrives and opens the museum.

achievements.name: Resident Services
achievements.detail: Upgrade the Resident Services tent into the permanent building on the plaza.

achievements.name: Able Sisters
achievements.detail: Shop with Mabel until the Able Sisters open their tailor shop on the island.

achievements.name: Public Works
achievements.detail: Have Resident Services build either a bridge or an incline.

achievements.name: K.K. Slider
achievements.detail: Raise the island to a three-star rating so K.K. Slider comes to play.

achievements.name: Island Designer
achievements.detail: Unlock the Island Designer app and change the shape of a river or a cliff.

achievements.name: Turnip Trade
achievements.detail: Buy turnips from Daisy Mae and sell them at Nook's Cranny for more than you paid.

achievements.name: Happy Home Paradise
achievements.detail: Design a vacation home for a client at Paradise Planning.

achievements.name: Five-Star Island
achievements.detail: Keep developing the island until Isabelle rates it five stars.
